items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Because you know, Lindbergh had just made his flight to Europe, and they had taken the name Lindy Hop

ctx.x: Boy, they were cuttin' them rugs, and one thing and another... Because you know, Lindbergh had just made his flight to Europe, and they had taken the name Lindy Hop, and it was this dance... And boy, the way they was throwin' their partners around and lifting them up in the air, and doin' all that gymnastics stuff and one thing and another...
You had to be young for that.
